name: Follistatin (FST-344)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: Follistatin (FST-344) is a recombinant protein supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 1 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Store the lyophilized powder at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is Follistatin (FST-344) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Follistatin (FST-344) is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the FST certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (no public CAS entry).

faq.question: How should Follistatin (FST-344) be stored?
faq.answer: Dry powder for Follistatin (FST-344): store at −20 °C. Working solution: 2–8 °C, used within the window printed on the FST lot certificate.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for Follistatin (FST-344)?
faq.answer: Follistatin (FST-344) is stocked in 1 pack size (1 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $192.20; 10–49 kits falls to $176.82 (−8%) and 50+ to $163.36 (−15%).
